description: Alpha Phone AOSP product descriptor for the Cuttlefish validation target. The Pixel 10a (stallion) Android 17 hardware product has its own descriptor (physicalProduct) and source lock; the Cuttlefish product never stages against a separate lock. Its source lock is the shared reviewed cuttlefish profile, which admits this product because its brand config inherits only that profile's required device tree (vendor/eliza/packages/os/scripts/android/cuttlefish-product.mjs). scripts/stage-aosp.mjs --production refuses to stage while any field here, in the brand config or in the selected source-lock profile is UNSET or a placeholder. Values are reviewed source and artifact identities only; no key material belongs here.
